title: The Spinning Mill
description: Mechanical carders untangle and align raw magenta wool fibers in a factory in Millbury, Massachusetts. Christopher Payne has explored the ins and outs of how everyday things are made in his photography for almost 20 years.
translated_description: 机械梳毛机在马萨诸塞州米尔伯里的一家工厂里解开并理顺品红色原羊毛纤维。近20年来，克里斯托弗·佩恩一直在他的摄影作品中探索日常物品制造过程的方方面面。
